tags: Planarity explores the intersection of planar and non-planar surfaces. Each surface generated has a its own contours and movement that undulate indefinitely. The planes are also infinitely scalable and can be run on any sized screens in live mode
making each edition a distinctive piece of generative video art.   Press 's' on your keyboard to save a screenshot while in live mode.
